A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to provide a conceptual framework to guide the decision-making process of MPAs, and we have shown how to apply it to a particular case study.
the 'MPA process' is not a linear, one-directional process, but rather a circular process in which the different steps are repeated in an iterative manner.

the decision making process is most complex in temperate continental soft-bottom marine areas because of the conflicting interests between fisheries and conservation.
